Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop

Meal_1: Option 1: Idli (2) & sambar (1 cup) & paneer cubes (60 g)
Option 2: Vegetable dosa (1) & dal (1 small bowl)
Option 3: Vegetable upma (1 medium bowl) & curd (small cup)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & dal (1 bowl) & vegetable curry
Option 2: 2 chapati & paneer curry (80 g paneer) & salad
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & sambar & vegetable fry
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & dal (light) & vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Since your goal is mental wellbeing, keep meals simple and consistent to reduce stress around food decisions.
Sleep is less than 6 hours, so keep dinner lighter and avoid very spicy foods late at night.
Because you prefer a fixed routine, try to repeat the same meal timing daily.
Make paneer or dal the main portion to support steady energy during desk work.
Simple home style cooking will help you stay consistent long term.
